title: Error budget reclamation flow and initiative sunset guidelines
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Teams often continue long-running reliability initiatives after their allocated error budget is exhausted, creating invisible resource contention and blocking higher-priority work. We lack a clear, documented process for reclaiming unused or overspent error budget, sunsetting initiatives that no longer meet ROI or SLI targets, and communicating reallocation decisions across squads.

Goal: Define an operational "reclamation + sunset" flow that ties initiative lifecycle decisions to measurable SLI and error-budget signals, with clear owner handoffs, automated ledger adjustments, and minimal manual overhead. Deliverables include: 1) a decision playbook (when to pause, throttle, or sunset an initiative), 2) a set of automated ledger updates and notifications, 3) dashboards and alerts to surface candidates for reclamation, and 4) a lightweight stakeholder communication template and escalation path.

Scope: Console-level tooling (initiative metadata + automated ledger), product-level playbook and templates, and a small server-side automation in the Reliability Initiative Hub to adjust allocations and create tickets. DOES NOT include deep runtime changes (that remains ENG scope) nor billing rework.

Measures of success: time from alert to decision <= 72h for high-priority initiatives, reclaimed error-budget >= 20% of overspent allocation for first quarter pilot, and >75% of reclamation decisions logged in the ledger with a reason code.
acceptance_criteria: A documented playbook in Confluence that lists triggers, decision thresholds, and owner roles
An automated ledger workflow that sets initiative state to 'paused' or 'sunset' and records reason codes (pilot enabled in Reliability Initiative Hub)
Grafana dashboard with candidate list powered by SLI burn rates, recent deploys, and customer-impact tags
Notification templates and an escalation path (Slack + email) exercised in a dry-run
One pilot completed across two teams with retrospective notes and metrics in the ticket
comments: 2025-07-12 - Ava Martinez (creator): Drafted ticket after cross-functional discussion w/ Reliability and Platform. Initial ask: standardize when we reclaim error budget and how to sunset low ROI initiatives. Shared initial problem statement in Reliability sync. Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Reliability/Error+Budget+Reclamation (work-in-progress).

2025-07-14 - Liam O'Connell (assignee): Met with ENG infra and Console UX. Two constraints surfaced: (1) we should avoid any automated hard-sunset without human approval, (2) the ledger API needs an additional field for 'reclamation_reason' and 'reclaimed_by'. Filed ENG dependency: ENG-34121 to add ledger fields and API endpoints.

2025-07-16 - Engineering (note from Priya Desai): Trade-off analysis: fully manual vs semi-automated flow. Recommendation: semi-automated alerts that can flip initiative state to 'paused' via a one-click approval in Console. Manual required for 'sunset'. This limits blast radius and preserves human contextual judgment. Added to Confluence design doc. GitHub RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfc/pull/142

2025-07-18 - Design review (Elena Park): Proposed UI pattern for pause/sunset action in Initiative drawer. Small inline confirmation and clear link to SLI burn history. UX mockups uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xXYZ-mockups

2025-07-20 - Reliability (note from Marco Li): Thresholds proposal: candidate when 7-day SLI burn rate > 60% ofallocated error budget AND no measurable improvement after two deploys or 14 days. For high-customer-impact initiatives require SRE/PM sync before pause. Added 'customer_impact' tag to candidate scoring.

2025-07-22 - PM review (Ava): Updated acceptance criteria to require pilot across two product teams. Noted need for communication templates for affected stakeholders and customers. Added labels and release target console-2025.08.

2025-07-23 - ENG update (Liam): ENG-34121 PR opened to extend ledger API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/589. Initial automated job skeleton to run candidate scorer queued in infra. Added metrics for 'reclamation latency' to internal telemetry.

2025-07-24 - Implementation note (Liam): Decided to implement candidate scorer as a weekly batch job to start (less risk). Score factors: 7-day burn, deploy frequency, customer_impact, initiative age, and recent rollback rate. Batch job will populate a 'reclamation_candidates' view in the Hub DB. Next step: wire alerts & Console action buttons.

2025-07-25 - Stakeholder alignment (Ava): Sync scheduled with customer-success and legal for downstream communications. Created template for public status update and internal change log. Plan pilot: teams 'Search' and 'Embeddings' in Aug 2025.
Action items: (1) ENG finish ledger API (ENG-34121), (2) Console UX to implement pause confirmation (DES-90412 placeholder), (3) Run weekly dry-run for two weeks before any actual state change.
